clips.title: The story
paras: Bloodmage Thalnos is a skeletal spellcaster who haunts the Graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery. Once a sadistic interrogator within the Scarlet Crusade, he succumbed to the plague of undeath he fanatically fought against, yet he remains entrenched deep within their holy grounds.

Within the zealous ranks of the Scarlet Crusade, Thalnos earned dark notoriety for his brutal methods of torture, used under the guise of purifying prospective recruits of taint. Yet despite his fanatical devotion to rooting out corruption, the sadistic mage ultimately succumbed to the plague of undeath. Rather than being cleansed or permanently destroyed, he rose as a withered skeleton, still clinging to his fiery magic and arcane mastery.
